rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
Students must take a minimum of twenty units: One Core Course for 4 or 5 units from the of the Core Clusters, and at least five other elective courses of at least three units each.
Students complete twenty or more units in courses relevant to department majors across the university, including but not limited to Anthropology, Art, Communications, Computer Science, Data Science, East Asian Languages and Cultures, Engineering, English, French, History, Italian, Linguistics, Music, Philosophy, Religious Studies, and Theatre and Performance. These electives are to be determined in consultation with the Director of the DH Minor (a faculty member in English).
NOTE: Not all courses are offered every year. Courses do not need to be taken in sequential order, although it can be helpful to build a program based around your select Core course.

rules.name: Required Core Course
rules.desc:
Complete one Core Course from one of the following Clusters (see DH Minor Website for year to year offerings):

• Spatial Humanities (e.g. CLASSICS115: Virtual Italy; HISTORY201B: Spatial History: Concepts, Methods, Problems)

• Quantitative Text Analysis (e.g. ENG184E: Literary Text Mining; ENG184F: Literary Text Mining 2: Studies in Cultural Analytics)

• Text Technologies (e.g. History207: Crafting Digital Stories; CSRE166: African Archives Beyond Colonization)

rules.name: Elective Courses
rules.desc:
Students must complete a total of 5 elective courses of 3 units or higher for a total of at least 15 units from the clusters below.
When choosing electives, it may be helpful to think about them as part of the topical clusters listed below.
Not all of the courses below may be available this year, but the clusters are representative of the kinds of courses compatible with the DH minor.
You might wish to focus your study on one cluster, with one or two courses from related clusters, or you might want to prioritize breadth in your studies.
